correctness.rationale: PASS: On connected simple G, summing period-three updates makes the per-vertex firing count harmonic, hence uniformly 1 or 2 for primitive cycles. For one firing, each phase s(v) requires predecessor-neighbor count a_v>=1 and height 0<=u_v<a_v. Counting edges gives chip energy m+h(s)+sum u_v and full integer interval [m+h(s),2m-n]; complementation x->2d-1-x yields high interval [2m,3m-n-h(s)]. Phase rotations divide by three; resulting polynomial, reciprocity and endpoints follow. Independent direct F^3 enumeration matched phase polynomial on triangle, C4, K4 and B2; K4 coefficients 12 each.
